bg-29-01.hint: The teacher comes into the classroom.
bg-29-01.why: When honoring the subject, attach -(으)시- to the verb: 오- + -(으)세요 = 오세요.

bg-29-01.q: State that the teacher reads a book using 선생님 and 책을 읽으세요.
bg-29-01.why: When the subject is an elder or teacher, the verb takes -(으)시-: 읽- + -으세요 = 읽으세요.

steps.en: The teacher reads a book in the classroom.

ko: 선생님이 교실에 오셔서 학생들과 반갑게 인사하세요.
학생들이 자리에 앉자 선생님이 책을 펴고 읽으세요.
선생님의 설명을 들으면서 우리는 열심히 필기해요.
en: The teacher comes into the classroom and greets the students warmly.
As students sit in their seats, the teacher opens a book and reads.
Listening to the teacher's explanation, we take notes diligently.

bg-29-01.q: What does the teacher do after coming into the classroom?
bg-29-01.why: The text says '선생님이 교실에 오셔서 학생들과 반갑게 인사하세요'.

bg-29-01.q: What do the students do while listening to the explanation?
bg-29-01.why: The text states '선생님의 설명을 들으면서 우리는 열심히 필기해요'.

items: Attach -(으)시- to honor elders performing actions
Avoid mistakenly using -(으)시- when referring to your own actions

bg-29-02.hint: I gave a letter to the teacher.
bg-29-02.why: To an honored recipient, use particle 께 and humble verb 드리다: 선생님께 편지를 드렸어요.

bg-29-02.q: State that grandmother comes home using 할머니께서 and 집에 오세요.
bg-29-02.why: Honorific subject particle 께서 pairs harmoniously with verb ending 오세요: 할머니께서 집에 오세요.

steps.en: I gave a letter to the teacher.
On Teacher's Day, I gave a letter to the teacher.

ko: 스승의 날을 맞이하여 반 친구들과 함께 선생님께 작은 선물을 준비했어요.
우리는 선생님께 감사의 마음을 담은 편지도 드렸어요.
en: To mark Teacher's Day, I prepared a small gift for the teacher with my classmates.
The teacher received the gift and smiled brightly.
We also gave the teacher a letter filled with gratitude.

bg-29-02.q: Why did the students prepare a gift for the teacher?
options: Because the teacher was leaving school
bg-29-02.why: The text begins '스승의 날을 맞이하여 반 친구들과 함께 선생님께 작은 선물을 준비했어요'.

bg-29-02.q: What did the students give along with the gift?
bg-29-02.why: The text says '우리는 선생님께 감사의 마음을 담은 편지도 드렸어요'.

items: Replace 이/가 with 께서 when the subject is an honored person
Replace 에게/한테 with 께 when the recipient is an elder

bg-29-03.hint: Mother calls grandmother on the phone.
bg-29-03.why: Mother is the respected subject (께서), grandmother is the respected recipient (께), and the verb agrees with -세요.

bg-29-03.q: Describe mother calling grandmother using 어머니께서 and 할머니께 전화를 하세요.
bg-29-03.why: Mother is the honored subject (어머니께서) and grandmother is the honored recipient (할머니께).

steps.en: On weekend mornings, mother calls grandmother.

ko: 주말 아침이면 어머니께서 고향에 계신 할머니께 안부 전화를 하세요.
아버지께서는 거실에서 따뜻한 차를 드시면서 신문을 읽으세요.
온 가족이 평화롭고 따뜻한 주말을 보내요.
en: On weekend mornings, mother makes an inquiry phone call to grandmother in the hometown.
Father drinks warm tea and reads the newspaper in the living room.
The whole family spends a peaceful and warm weekend.

bg-29-03.q: What does mother do on weekend mornings?
bg-29-03.why: The text says '어머니께서 고향에 계신 할머니께 안부 전화를 하세요'.

bg-29-03.q: What does father do in the living room?
options: Drinks tea and reads the newspaper
bg-29-03.why: The text states '아버지께서는 거실에서 따뜻한 차를 드시면서 신문을 읽으세요'.

items: Harmonize subject honorifics (께서) and recipient honorifics (께) within one sentence
Describe family scenes and respectful interactions accurately

bg-29-04.hint: I took my parents to the hospital.
bg-29-04.why: When accompanying elders, use the humble verb 모시다 instead of 데리다: 모시고 갔어요.

bg-29-04.q: Describe taking your grandmother to the hospital using 할머니를 모시고 and 병원에 갔어요.
bg-29-04.why: When accompanying an elder, use the humble verb 모시다: 모시고 갔어요.

bg-29-04.hint: Upgrade both the noun for birthday (생일 → 생신) and the verb for giving to an elder (주다 → 드리다).
bg-29-04.why: Respect towards mother requires honorific vocabulary: 생신 and 선물을 드렸어요.

steps.en: I took grandmother to the hospital.
Yesterday morning, I took grandmother to the hospital.

ko: 우리 가족은 어머니께 예쁜 꽃다발과 선물을 드렸어요.
저녁에는 맛있는 식당에 부모님을 모시고 가서 함께 즐거운 시간을 보냈어요.
en: Our family gave a pretty flower bouquet and a gift to mother.
In the evening, we took our parents to a delicious restaurant and had an enjoyable time together.

bg-29-04.q: What special occasion was celebrated yesterday?
bg-29-04.why: The text begins '어제는 어머니의 쉰 번째 생신이었어요'.

bg-29-04.q: Where did the family go in the evening?
options: To a delicious restaurant with their parents
To an airport to greet relatives
bg-29-04.why: The text says '저녁에는 맛있는 식당에 부모님을 모시고 가서 함께 즐거운 시간을 보냈어요'.

items: Apply honorific nouns (진지, 생신) and special honorific verbs (드시다, 주무시다)
Use humble verbs (드리다, 모시다) correctly when talking about actions towards elders
